def analyze(demo):
    A=G[f'Demo pair {demo} input'];B=G[f'Demo pair {demo} output']
    bgv=Counter(A[i][j] for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(len(A[0]))).most_common(1)[0][0]
    oa=objs(A,bgv); ob=objs(B,bgv)
    print(f'--- demo {demo}: bg={bgv}; in {len(oa)} out {len(ob)}')
    for o in sorted(oa,key=lambda o:min(r for r,c in o)):
        rs=[r for r,c in o]; cs=[c for r,c in o]
        print('  IN',min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs),'size',len(o),'bbox rows',max(rs)-min(rs)+1,'cols',max(cs)-min(cs)+1)
        for rr in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1):
            print('     ',''.join(str(A[rr][cc]) if (rr,cc) in set(o) else '.' for cc in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)))
analyze(6)
